config.label: Smarter Weather API key (sw_live_* or sw_test_*) with the 'mcp' scope
config.description: Smarter Weather API key (sw_live_* or sw_test_*) with the 'mcp' scope. When set (and not an unexpanded ${…} placeholder), the bridge forwards Authorization via SMARTERWEATHER_AUTH_HEADER in the child env — never on argv. When unset, falls through to SMARTERWEATHER_ENV_FILE then cwd/.env; with no key, discovery tools stay free and other tool calls return x402 payment requirements. Mint with `npx -y @smarterweather/mcp-onboarding@latest login` or trial.

config.label: Override the target MCP endpoint
config.description: Override the target MCP endpoint. Useful for development or staging against a non-production sw-mcp deployment. Precedence: positional argument > SMARTERWEATHER_MCP_URL > package default (https://mcp.smarterweather.com).
